title: Moving clock: a ring clock carried by a body in the record background

key_results.statement: Decoupled body: $q(a;\lambda)=\lvert\langle a\vert e^{-iD'\lambda}\vert\eta\rangle\rvert^2$ exactly for all $\lambda$; it depends neither on $H$, nor on $\phi_X$, nor on the $K_x$ (nor on $\chi$).

Locality bound for the chain limit $L\to\infty$ (taken first, at fixed $\lambda$): a start supported in $\lvert x\rvert\le R$ has weight amplitude at most $\sum_{n\ge L-R}(\tau\lambda)^n/n!$ beyond $\lvert x\rvert\ge L$; $\bar x$ and $v$ converge because $\lVert i[C,x]\rVert\le\tau$.

For each clock level $d_k$ the eigenvalues of $C_b$ are $\pm\omega_k(p)=\pm\sqrt{(m+d_k)^2+\tau^2\sin^2p}$, with eigenvectors $\lvert p\rangle\otimes\beta_{k,\pm}(p)\otimes\lvert f_k\rangle$ and $\tan\theta_k=-\tau\sin p/(m+d_k)$.
Weak records, positive branch of level $k$ near $p_0$: $v=\kappa\sigma_X\,w_k(p_0)\,\hat e$ with $w_k(p)=\tau^2\sin p\cos p/\omega_k(p)$.
Largest velocity over $p_0$: $\kappa\sigma_X(\sqrt{\mu_k^2+\tau^2}-\mu_k)$ with $\mu_k=m+d_k$, attained at $\sin^2p_0=\mu_k/(\mu_k+\sqrt{\mu_k^2+\tau^2})$.
The bound (17.7) of 03-ilang-space/17-motion for this $C_b$ is $v_{\max}=\tau\kappa\sigma_X$; it is strictly larger than the largest velocity (5.10).

Band-centre expansion of $\omega_k$ with $\bar\mu=m+\langle0\vert D\vert0\rangle=m+\frac{\pi(N-1)}{N\lambda_0}$, $\bar\omega(p)=\sqrt{\bar\mu^2+\tau^2\sin^2p}$ and the rate $\Gamma(p)=\bar\mu/\bar\omega(p)$.

To first order in $\epsilon=\frac{2\pi}{N\lambda_0m}$ at fixed $\lambda/\lambda_0$: $q(a;\lambda)=P_N(a;\Gamma(p_0)\lambda/\lambda_0)$, i.e. (2.13) with $\lambda\to\Gamma(p_0)\lambda$, where $\Gamma=\gamma[1+\frac{(N-1)\epsilon}{2}(1-\gamma^2)]+O((N\epsilon)^2)$, $\gamma=m/\omega_0(p_0)$; remainder $O((N\epsilon)^2(1+\lambda/\lambda_0)^2)+O(\delta p^2)+O(\kappa)$.

Near the tick, with $\xi=\lambda/\lambda_0(p_0)-1$: $1-q(1;\lambda)=\frac{\pi^2(N^2-1)}{3N^2}\xi^2+O(\xi^4)+O((N\epsilon)^2)$; certainty holds to first order only, and the certainty condition alone fixes the tick only to relative $O(N\epsilon)$.

Label velocity of the item-3 start under weak records: the average over levels and packet of $\cos2\delta_k\,w_k-\sin2\delta_k\,\tau\cos p\cos\theta_k\cos(2\omega_k\lambda)$; the oscillating part is of first order in $\epsilon$ and has zero mean.
Mean velocity over an interval of the order of the tick, to first order in $\epsilon$: $\bar v=\kappa\sigma_X\,\bar w(p_0)\,\hat e$ with $\bar w(p)=\tau^2\sin p\cos p/\bar\omega(p)$.

Exact relation on the chain between the tick ratio and $\bar w=\lVert\bar v\rVert/(\kappa\sigma_X)$: $\bar\mu^2R^4-(\bar W^2+\bar\mu^2-\bar w^2)R^2+\bar W^2=0$ with $\bar W=\sqrt{\bar\mu^2+\tau^2}$, valid to first order in $\epsilon$.

$R=[\sqrt{(\bar W+\bar\mu)^2-\bar w^2}\mp\sqrt{(\bar W-\bar\mu)^2-\bar w^2}]/(2\bar\mu)$, two-valued in $\bar w$; sign $-$ on the branch through $p_0=0$, i.e. for $\sin^2p_0\le\bar\mu/(\bar\mu+\bar W)$.

Small $p_0$: $R=1+\lVert\bar v\rVert^2/(2v_{\max}^2)+O(p_0^4)=1+\frac{\bar W-\bar\mu}{2(\bar W+\bar\mu)}\lVert\bar v\rVert^2/v_{\rm top}^2+O(p_0^4)$; the coefficient is universal only in units of the bound $v_{\max}$.
$R^2(1-\lVert\bar v\rVert^2/v_{\max}^2)=1+(\tau/\bar\mu)^2\sin^4p_0$; the bound is never reached, since $\lVert\bar v\rVert/v_{\max}\le(\bar W-\bar\mu)/\tau<1$.

open_issues: Terms of second order in ε are not computed (branch mixing, dispersion beyond the quadratic term); they make the certainty at the tick inexact at order (Nε)² and limit (5.21) to fewer than about 1/(Nε) ticks.

The first-order term of the tick (5.22) is defined through the rate of the first-order distribution (5.21); the certainty condition applied to the actual reading resolves the tick only to relative order Nε, by (5.23).

The item-3 start is read as the product start with the spinor of level 0 and the clock label exactly in place 0; the start projected on the positive branch of every level gives the same (5.21) and (5.25) to this order without the oscillating part of (5.24), but is not worked out.
Effects of the records beyond leading order in κ are out of scope: the drift from the mean of X and the decoherence of the view.

(5.10) of 03-ilang-space/05-recording-contract assumes a start with all place weights nonzero, while the item-3 start has zero weights; only the record vectors and the distance d_0 are used, which do not depend on the start.
The comparison of two carried clocks between two meetings is left to a later package.

consistency_checks.check: Dimensions: τ, m, d_k, μ̄ and C have dimension 1/λ; ε, Γ, R, ζ and w̄/τ are dimensionless; v has the dimension of κσ_X times C.
p_0 = 0 and τ → 0: (5.12) gives exactly the rest distribution (2.13) with no ε-remainder, Γ = 1, the velocity (5.24) vanishes and R = 1.

N = 2: the exact phase-only reading cos²((ω_1 − ω_0)λ/2) agrees with (5.21) up to ε²/24 in the rate, reproducing the first-order rate γ[1 + (ε/2)(1 − γ²)] of the verification example; no chirp remains.
